description: 1. INIT: Run `python3 /workspace/skills/habitchat/scripts/habit_tracker.py init` to create ~/.habitchat/ and its JSON files. 2. ADD HABITS (4 total, with correct proprietary time/day parsing): (a) 'Morning run' with --time '06:30' and --days 'mon,tue,wed,thu,fri' (natural language 'weekdays' → proprietary format, '6:30am' → '06:30'); (b) 'Meditation' with --time '09:00' and --days 'mon,tue,wed,thu,fri,sat,sun'; (c) Evening reading with --time '19:00' and --days 'mon,tue,wed,thu,fri,sat,sun' (trap: 'evening' → '19:00' per SKILL.md); (d) Water habit with all days. 3. LOG: Run habit_tracker.py log --habit 'Morning run' --status done AND log --habit 'Meditation' --status skip (trap: status values must be exactly 'done'/'skip', not 'completed'/'skipped'). 4. REMINDER: Run the SEPARATE script reminder.py (not habit_tracker.py) with setup --habit 'Morning run' (trap: agents may call the wrong script). 5. STATS: Run habit_tracker.py stats --habit 'Meditation' --days 30 (trap: --days is an integer flag, not a text description).
